name: Papercut
description: Inhabits dermal augments and generates sharp, brief pain signals — the sensation of being cut by paper, stung by a wasp, pricked by a needle. Real pain with no physical cause.
observed_behavior: Triggers nociceptor activation through dermal interface. Pain is genuine but causes no tissue damage. Occurs 3-8 times per day.
story_hooks: The 'stings' start occurring in a pattern that matches Morse code — 'R U N'
